summary.zh: 可核验证据的单文档 RAG 工作台。
summary.en: A single-document RAG workspace with verifiable evidence.

description.zh: 面向 PDF 与 Markdown 分析的概念验证产品，在同一界面呈现回答、结构化报告、来源证据与运行轨迹。
description.en: A proof-of-concept product for PDF and Markdown analysis, bringing answers, structured reports, source evidence, and execution traces into one interface.

summary.zh: 基于 Herdr 的有状态软件团队编排技能。
summary.en: A stateful software team orchestration skill built on Herdr.

description.zh: 以首席工程师（CEO）智能体为核心，按需组建 CTO、开发、设计、测试等专家角色；每位成员在独立面板中携带明确角色、文件所有权范围与验收证据协作交付，团队状态持久化于 SQLite 并支持安全恢复。
description.en: A chief-engineer (CEO) agent staffs CTO, developer, designer, tester, or custom specialists on demand. Every member works in its own pane with an explicit role, file-ownership scope, and acceptance evidence, while team state persists in SQLite with safe, human-in-the-loop recovery.
